items.t: US unveils new tariffs on China, EU and others
items.d: Washington proposed fresh levies on many of its biggest trading partners, with China facing rates reported at up to 40%. The move risks reigniting trade tensions and pushing up prices.

items.t: Fuel tanker crash and fire kills 31 in Cairo
items.d: A tanker reportedly overturned on a busy Cairo ring road and burst into flames on Wednesday evening, killing at least 31 people and injuring 21.

items.t: Ukraine says strike hit five Russian military jets
items.d: Kyiv says it struck Savasleyka airfield, home to aircraft Russia uses to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs, damaging five jets.

items.t: Colombian police free 76 hostages after 17-hour siege
items.d: Police stormed a Cartagena supermarket where gunmen had held 76 people after a botched armoured-car robbery; one gunman was killed.

items.t: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
items.d: Pyongyang ordered Switzerland's envoy out and its newly reopened office shut after Swiss sanctions. Bern says contact will continue via embassies in Bern and Beijing.

items.t: Solomon Islands swaps China security pact for Australia deal
items.d: The Pacific nation ended its contested 2022 security pact with Beijing and signed a treaty with Australia, a notable shift in regional influence.

items.t: Ramaphosa wins court fight over impeachment threat
items.d: A court set aside the Phala Phala panel report on cash stolen from his farm, removing the basis for parliament's impeachment process.

items.t: US inflation gauge rises to 3.8% in October
items.d: The Fed's preferred price measure accelerated again, with core prices above forecasts, strengthening bets on a December rate rise.

items.t: Anthropic shares slip below $83 IPO price
items.d: Days after its Nasdaq debut, the AI firm's stock closed under its offer price as worries about the AI trade returned, though most analysts stay positive.

items.t: Poundland collapses, putting 11,000 jobs at risk
items.d: The discount chain fell into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer, another blow to the UK high street.

items.t: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year
items.d: Financial disclosures show the president's portfolios regularly traded the chipmaker's stock, raising conflict-of-interest questions over chip policy.

items.t: US approves SpaceX plan for a million data satellites
items.d: The FCC cleared SpaceX's Starmind constellation of orbital data centres, pitched as a cheaper, more energy-efficient way to meet AI computing demand.

items.t: US blacklists Megaspeed amid Nvidia export scrutiny
items.d: The Commerce Department added Megaspeed to its entity list, as lawmakers press Nvidia's Jensen Huang over chip export controls to China.

items.t: Amazon says AI agent exploited a zero-day largely alone
items.d: Amazon's security team detected an open-source AI agent that mostly autonomously exploited an unknown flaw, a warning sign for cyber defenders.

items.t: Hong Kong URBTIX hack exposes 1.3 million users
items.d: Personal data of about 1.3 million users of the government ticketing system were accessed illegally; a contractor reported the attack on Tuesday.

items.t: Tidal to remove millions of AI-generated tracks
items.d: The music streamer will ban and delete fully AI-made songs as so-called AI slop floods streaming platforms.

items.t: Meta puts its Muse AI assistant into Instagram DMs
items.d: Users can now chat with Meta's assistant directly inside Instagram messages, part of a push to put AI agents into everyday apps.

items.t: China's Shenzhou-24 lifts off with first Pakistani astronaut
items.d: China launched three astronauts to its Tiangong space station, including Pakistan's first astronaut, expanding Beijing's space partnerships.

items.t: Wisconsin reports third measles death
items.d: The outbreak has reached about 920 cases since late summer, as falling vaccination rates fuel the spread across the US.

items.t: Study links GLP-1 weight-loss drugs to denser breasts
items.d: A small study of 104 women found higher breast density on mammograms, which can make cancer harder to spot; larger studies are needed.

items.t: Government to publish new treaties agreed with EU
items.d: The treaties reportedly include a 10-year termination clause covering the cost of rebuilding border checks, part of Labour's reset with Brussels.

items.t: Stalking law simplified into a single offence
items.d: A review found existing stalking laws confusing, so they will be merged into one new offence to make prosecutions easier.

items.t: Met Office: fewer frosts, more hot days as seasons shift
items.d: Britain's seasons are changing, affecting wildlife and leading some farmers to grow different crops.

items.t: 美國宣布向中國、歐盟等多國徵新關稅
items.d: 華府建議向多個主要貿易夥伴加徵關稅，報道指中國稅率最高達40%。措施或再度觸發貿易緊張，並推高物價。

items.t: 開羅油缸車撞車起火 最少31死
items.d: 一輛油缸車周三晚據報在開羅繁忙環迴公路翻側起火，造成最少31人死亡、21人受傷。

items.t: 烏克蘭稱襲擊俄軍機場 擊中五架軍機
items.d: 基輔稱襲擊薩瓦斯列伊卡機場，擊中五架戰機；該機場駐有俄軍用來發射高超音速導彈及滑翔炸彈的軍機。

items.t: 哥倫比亞警方解救76名人質 對峙17小時
items.d: 警方突入卡塔赫納一間超市，解救被持槍匪徒挾持的76人；事件源於劫運鈔車失手，一名匪徒被擊斃。

items.t: 朝鮮因制裁爭拗驅逐瑞士外交官
items.d: 平壤因瑞士實施制裁，下令瑞士外交官離境並關閉剛重開的辦事處。瑞方稱會透過伯爾尼及北京的使館保持聯繫。

items.t: 所羅門群島棄中國安全協議 改與澳洲簽約
items.d: 這個太平洋島國終止與北京具爭議的安全協議，改與澳洲簽訂條約，反映區內影響力出現明顯轉變。

items.t: 南非總統拉馬福薩贏得彈劾官司
items.d: 法院撤銷有關其農場現金被盜的「法拉法拉」調查報告，令國會彈劾程序失去依據。

items.t: 美國10月PCE通脹升至3.8%
items.d: 聯儲局最重視的通脹指標再度加快，核心物價高於預期，加強市場對12月加息的預期。

items.t: Anthropic股價跌穿83美元招股價
items.d: 這家AI公司在納斯特克上市數日後，股價收市跌穿招股價，市場再度憂慮AI板塊，但多數分析員仍看好。

items.t: Poundland倒閉 1.1萬職位不保
items.d: 這家平價連鎖店東主未能覓得買家，公司進入破產管理，對英國零售大街再添打擊。

items.t: 特朗普戶口今年44次買賣Nvidia股票
items.d: 財務申報顯示總統的投資組合經常買賣這家晶片商股票，令人質疑其晶片政策涉利益衝突。

items.t: 美國批准SpaceX發射百萬顆數據衞星
items.d: 聯邦通訊委員會批准SpaceX的Starmind軌道數據中心星群，SpaceX稱這是應付AI運算需求更便宜、更節能的方法。

items.t: 美國將Megaspeed列入實體清單
items.d: 美國商務部將Megaspeed列入實體清單，國會議員亦就晶片出口管制向Nvidia行政總裁黃仁勳施壓。

items.t: Amazon稱AI代理幾乎自主利用零日漏洞
items.d: Amazon保安團隊發現一個開源AI代理幾乎自主地利用未知漏洞發動攻擊，為網絡防衞敲響警號。

items.t: 城市售票網遭入侵 130萬用戶資料外洩
items.d: 政府城市售票網遭黑客入侵，約130萬名用戶個人資料被非法存取，承辦商周二通報事件。

items.t: Tidal將刪除數以百萬計AI生成歌曲
items.d: 串流音樂平台Tidal將禁止並刪除全由AI製作的歌曲，以應對大量劣質AI內容湧入串流平台。

items.t: Meta把Muse AI助手加入Instagram私訊
items.d: 用戶現可直接在Instagram私訊中使用Meta的AI助手，是Meta將AI代理融入日常應用程式的一步。

items.t: 神舟二十四號升空 載首名巴基斯坦太空人
items.d: 中國發射神舟二十四號，把三名太空人送往天宮太空站，當中包括巴基斯坦首名太空人，擴大中國的太空合作。

items.t: 美國威斯康星州錄第三宗麻疹死亡
items.d: 當地疫情自夏末以來約有920宗個案，疫苗接種率下降令麻疹在美國擴散。

items.t: 研究指GLP-1減肥藥或令乳房密度增加
items.d: 一項涉及104名女性的小型研究發現，她們的乳房X光片顯示密度增加，或令癌症較難察覺，仍需更大型研究。

items.t: 政府將公布與歐盟達成的新條約
items.d: 據報條約包含10年終止條款，涵蓋重建邊境檢查設施的費用，是工黨政府改善與歐盟關係的一部分。

items.t: 跟蹤法例簡化為單一罪行
items.d: 檢討發現現行跟蹤法例令人混淆，將合併為一項新罪行，以便檢控。

items.t: 氣象局：季節轉變 霜凍減少 炎熱日子增加
items.d: 英國季節正出現變化，影響野生動物，部分農民亦改種其他作物。
